description: What changes between the installed version of ONE dependency and a target version: changelog entries per release, breaking changes, deprecations, security fixes, and the files in this project that import it. Call before upgrading or bumping a dependency.

ecosystem.description: Registry. Default: inferred from the project's dependencies (required when the name exists in both).

from_version.description: Current version. Default: the version this project's lockfile resolves.

package.description: Package name exactly as published (npm: `zod`, `@scope/pkg`; crates.io: `fastembed`).

response_format.description: concise (default): every breaking/deprecation/security entry plus up to 3 others per version. detailed: all entries, capped at 400.

to_version.description: Target version. Default: the highest stable version on the registry.

name: upgrade_impact
title: Upgrade impact
